title: Show, Don't Just Tell
goal: Add an example so the robot copies the shape.
mascot_lines: Showing is way faster than telling.
Instead of explaining for a paragraph, give the helper one little example.
Like saying 'the list should look like Apple - red, Banana - yellow'.
The helper takes the shape of your example and copies it perfectly.

tier2.rephrase: Pick the message that gives the robot a tiny example to copy.

tier3.nudge: Examples often start with 'like this:' and show a sample.
